body_zh: 普通陈述句里，变位动词放在第二个位置：Ik werk vandaag.
把时间放到句首时，动词仍在第二位，主语就移到动词后面：Vandaag werk ik.
句首的一整个时间短语算一个位置；不要把主语和动词一起挪到后面。
body_en: In a statement, the conjugated verb takes the second position: Ik werk vandaag.
If time comes first, the verb stays second and the subject follows it: Vandaag werk ik.
A whole time phrase at the start counts as one position; do not move the subject and verb together.

examples.nl: Binnenkort ga ik naar Den Haag.
examples.en: Soon I will go to The Hague.
